company.name: Luma AI
company.shortDescription: Luma AI develops tools that let users generate photorealistic images and videos from text, image, or video prompts.
company.description: Luma AI develops tools that let users generate photorealistic images and videos from text, image, or video prompts via its Dream Machine platform. Its models learn from multimodal data, including video, audio, and language to build “world models” that can reason about motion, context, and physics. It provides access through a web app, iOS app, and API, enabling creative professionals to scale visuals for storytelling, advertising, animation, gaming, and more. For enterprises, Luma offers a secure full-stack solution with data ownership, legal clarity, and customizable AI models.
